summary: Review prediction and validation studies for leakage, target definition, calibration, holdout integrity and comparator strength.

must_inspect.why: A model cannot be validated more strongly than the target and reference are defined and measured.
false_positive_guards: Do not treat imperfect reference measurement as fatal unless it threatens the central inference.

must_inspect.why: Feature engineering, tuning and threshold selection should respect the claimed holdout boundary.
false_positive_guards: Cross-validation is not leakage by itself.

must_inspect.why: Discrimination alone may be insufficient when the use claim depends on probabilities or practical improvement.
false_positive_guards: Do not require calibration for a purely ranking use case unless probabilities are claimed.
A weak baseline can make improvement look larger; inspect comparator adequacy.
